ownerRole: Host Strategist / Brand Application Designer / Host Visual QA
question: Which host properties are protected product invariants, and which are replaceable remnants of the previous visual theme?
procedure: Freeze the host job, data fields, information-distribution model, interaction, route and business-semantic colors as protected product facts.
Inventory every visible first-viewport color, type treatment, radius, border, shadow, selected state and asset treatment from the host baseline.
Classify each visual producer as business-semantic, structural-neutral or replaceable-theme residue.
Preserve business semantics and product structure; replace theme residue with evidence-bound brand tokens or scoped recipes.
If an old visual is retained, record the business-semantic reason and verify it in the rendered first viewport.
Reject when unexplained old-theme signals remain dominant or occupy high-salience selected states.
notFor: Changing host data, routes, interaction or information architecture
Removing colors that encode business status without semantic review
Treating all host visuals as disposable
readerPurpose: 区分必须保护的宿主产品事实与必须替换的旧主题皮肤
